mdio_signal_timing.MDIO_TA_high_Z_window_clauses: Read transactions only; first TA bit must be high-Z on both ends, second TA bit driven 0 by PHY

frame_waveform.transmit: TX_EN ↑ on first preamble nibble → TXD shifts 7×0x55 + 0xD5 + DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad + FCS nibble-by-nibble → TX_EN ↓ on next TX_CLK after final FCS nibble → IFG (96 BT) before next TX_EN ↑.
frame_waveform.receive: PHY raises CRS as soon as line activity is detected → RX_DV ↑ aligned with first preamble nibble (or sometimes within the preamble) → RXD streams preamble + SFD + DA + ... + FCS → RX_DV ↓ before next RX_CLK after final FCS nibble → CRS ↓ shortly after.
frame_waveform.collision_half_duplex: (half-duplex only) During TX_EN, COL asserts as soon as the PHY detects a colliding signal; MAC immediately switches TXD to a 32-bit JAM pattern, then de-asserts TX_EN. After backoff slots, retry from TX_DEFER.

auto_negotiation_waveform.Acknowledge_propagation_pages: At least three identical Base Pages with Acknowledge bit set

transmitter_eye_reference_per_phy: MDI compliance eyes are specified per PMD clause: Figure 14-9 for 10BASE-T, Figure 25-? for 100BASE-TX, Figures 40-19..40-28 for 1000BASE-T. RJ-45 MDI return loss / NEXT specifications are also per PMD clause.
general_timing_rule: AFDX timing is deterministic and budgeted offline: each VL emits at most one frame per BAG (within the jitter bound); switches add bounded store-and-forward latency; the network is dimensioned so worst-case end-to-end latency is bounded for every VL. The redundant A/B copies are reconciled by Sequence-Number Integrity Checking and first-valid-wins Redundancy Management.

bag_waveform.definition: Minimum interval between the first bits of two consecutive frames on the same Virtual Link.

jitter_waveform.definition: Variation of a frame's presentation time vs the ideal BAG-spaced instant at the End System output.
jitter_waveform.note: computed from Lmax + link rate of the VLs sharing the port

redundancy_waveform.replication: frame sent on Network A and Network B (near-simultaneously)
redundancy_waveform.sequence_number: 1 byte appended before FCS; increments per VL frame; wraps 255→1 (0 reserved)
redundancy_waveform.first_valid_wins: receiver delivers the first valid copy of a given Sequence Number; discards the duplicate

frame_timing.shaping: transmit shaping to BAG + jitter; switch ingress policing (token/leaky-bucket)
